{"id": 138, "title": "damages-computation pack — Fee Schedule and Q2 Billing Summary (Harlow & Trent LLP / Meridian Fabrication engagement)", "doc_type": "billing_summary", "related_shape": "damages-computation", "body": "HARLOW & TRENT LLP — FEE SCHEDULE AND Q2 BILLING SUMMARY

Client: Meridian Fabrication Corp.  |  Engagement: Corvess litigation (No. 24-cv-8812)
Billing Partner: Elena Voss  |  Period: April 1 – June 30 (Q2)

Part A. Governing Fee Schedule (per the executed engagement letter, Exhibit B).
A.1 Partner time (Elena Voss): $950 per hour.
A.2 Senior Associate time (Daniel Okafor): $520 per hour.
A.3 Paralegal time (Reyna Solis): $210 per hour.
A.4 Negotiated client discount: a discount of 10% (ten percent) applies to PROFESSIONAL FEES ONLY. The discount does not apply to disbursements or other charges.
A.5 Disbursements are billed at cost with no markup and no discount.

Part B. Q2 Recorded Hours (final, as approved by the billing partner after write-downs).
B.1 Partner (Voss): 120 hours.
B.2 Senior Associate (Okafor): 310 hours.
B.3 Paralegal (Solis): 85 hours.

Part C. Q2 Disbursements (at cost).
C.1 Aggregate disbursements for the period: $12,455. This figure comprises deposition transcripts, service of process, and travel, and is billed without markup pursuant to A.5.

Part D. Invoice Computation Method (per engagement letter Section 7).
D.1 Step 1 — compute gross professional fees: multiply each timekeeper's Q2 hours in Part B by that timekeeper's hourly rate in Part A, and sum the three products.
D.2 Step 2 — apply the 10% negotiated discount from A.4 to the gross professional fees from Step 1 (fees only).
D.3 Step 3 — add the aggregate disbursements in C.1 to the discounted fees from Step 2. The result, rounded to whole dollars, is the invoice amount for the quarter.
D.4 The discount is never applied to disbursements, and disbursements are never discounted, netted, or prorated.

Part E. Notes.
E.1 The hours in Part B are final; no additional write-downs or premiums apply to Q2.
E.2 Rates in Part A are unchanged from Q1 and remain in effect until Amendment No. 3, if any, is executed.
E.3 Questions regarding this summary should be directed to the billing partner.

Prepared by the Harlow & Trent LLP billing department for the quarterly true-up of the client invoice record.
"}
